subject: Lockbox remittance, PO mapping and biweekly invoice cadence for Bellwether Health
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@bellwetherhealth.com>
To: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@bellwetherhealth.com, rajiv.menon@bellwetherhealth.com
Date: 2026-08-12T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New PO + remittance/terms question (PO #8421)

Hi Naomi,

Attached is PO 8421 for the upcoming Dedicated capacity work (start Sept). Procurement has two items to confirm before we finalize routing to AP:

1) Lockbox remittance: Bellwether requires invoices to be remitted via our bank lockbox (instructions attached). Can Redwood invoice to the lockbox account or do you require payments to route to a corporate ACH first?

2) Invoice cadence: Procurement prefers biweekly consolidated invoices (every other Friday) rather than monthly statements — are you able to accommodate that cadence for net terms?

3) Net terms: Our finance team is pushing for net45 on vendor invoices. Is Redwood able to accept net45 for this engagement, or do you need net30? If net45 is acceptable, are there any changes to pricing/discounts we should be aware of?

I attached the PO and our lockbox instructions. Please let me know the best point of contact for AP so we can set up remittance and PO matching rules in our ERP.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Senior Procurement Manager
Bellwether Health
Attachments: Bellwether_PO_8421.pdf; Lockbox_Instructions_bellwether.docx

From: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@bellwetherhealth.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-13T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New PO + remittance/terms question (PO #8421)

Elena —

Thanks for sending PO 8421 and the lockbox file. Quick responses to your three asks:

- Lockbox: We can support lockbox remittance directly, but our accounting team needs the exact bank account number + remittance identifier format (we typically include PO and a Redwood invoice match code in the ACH/lockbox reference). Can you confirm the required reference fields (PO, BU code, invoice ID)?

- Invoice cadence: Biweekly invoices are workable. We will need to confirm the invoice date cutoffs and whether you want a single consolidated invoice for all lines or separate invoices per PO line. Typical approach we use: one consolidated PDF per cycle, with line-level PO references.

- Net terms: Our standard is net30. For net45 we can agree to that if procurement can accept a 1% fee to offset extended float, or alternatively we can keep pricing flat but require a pre-authorized credit hold for the first 45 days. Happy to discuss which is easier for Bellwether.

Cc'ing Vanessa (account lead) and Vivek (sales engineering) to align on pricing and implementation. I will loop in Sales Ops once we have the preferred approach.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Manager, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0142
Attachments: W9_Redwood_Inference.pdf

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@bellwetherhealth.com>, naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-14T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New PO + remittance/terms question (PO #8421)

Elena — great to meet you over email. A few practical proposals so we can move this to AP: 

1) Terms compromise: Redwood can accept net45 with a 1% billing credit applied as an invoice-level line item (applied monthly), OR we can accept net45 at no change if Bellwether signs a 45-day payment amendment via DocuSign (this covers our internal credit policy). Which would you prefer?

2) Invoice format: We will produce a single consolidated PDF every other Friday (biweekly cycles) with line-item PO refs. We will also include a CSV remittance file for your lockbox processing if you can ingest that.

3) Required PO fields: Please confirm these exact fields on the PO so our AP can auto-match: PO number, BU code, GL account, cost center, and bill-to entity name. If Bellwether requires any bespoke header (e.g., EFIS code), send the example and we will map it.

If you confirm the lockbox reference format, I will ask Sales Ops to prepare the invoice template and DocuSign amendment.

Thanks — cc'ing Vivek for any technical notes on usage reporting.

Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: none

From: priyom.das@redwood.com
To: procurement@bellwetherhealth.com, naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-18T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: New PO + remittance/terms question (PO #8421)

Hi Elena / Bellwether AP —

Thanks for the materials. A few operational notes from Sales Ops to make lockbox processing smooth: 

- Remittance format: We can produce an ACH/lockbox CSV in this schema: invoice_id, invoice_date, invoice_total, po_number, bu_code, gl_account. Please confirm the exact column order and delimiter for your ERP import.

- Lockbox account: In your lockbox doc we see two inbound accounts (Checking 1 / Checking 2). Which should be used for Redwood invoices? Provide the 9-digit routing and account number you prefer; we will include it on the remit-to line.

- Invoice numbering: Redwood format is RWD-YYYY-XXXXX. If Bellwether's AP system requires a secondary vendor reference, advise the expected vendor_ref field and we will include it in the CSV.

- DocuSign amendment: Vanessa indicated a payment amendment might be required for net45. I attached a draft amendment that accepts net45 with a 1% adjustment credit; if Bellwether prefers the alternate (no-credit + signed amendment) we can update.

Next steps requested from Bellwether: 
- Confirm lockbox account choice and remittance reference fields
- Confirm preferred net45 option: (A) net45 + 1% credit OR (B) net45 + signed amendment (no credit)
- Confirm CSV/EDI import details (column order, delimiter)

Attachment: payment_amendment_draft_BW-8421.pdf

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Sales Operations, Redwood Inference

From: naomi.feldman@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@bellwetherhealth.com>, procurement@bellwetherhealth.com
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com, priyom.das@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-20T16:38:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New PO + remittance/terms question (PO #8421) — next steps

Elena / Bellwether team —

Appreciate the quick responses this week. Confirming next steps so AP has one thread to reference: 

1) Lockbox: Bellwether confirmed 'Checking 1' for Redwood invoices and requested remittance reference fields: PO number + BU code. We will include both in the CSV and on the invoice PDF. Please confirm the routing/account numbers by EOD Monday so finance can map.

2) Invoice cadence: We will move forward with biweekly consolidated invoices (every other Friday). First cycle invoice will be dated Friday, 2026-09-03 and will include usage through 2026-08-31. If you want an earlier sampling invoice we can accommodate a one-off.

3) Net terms: Bellwether indicated they prefer option B (net45 with signed amendment, no credit). Vanessa will send the DocuSign amendment; Priyom attached a draft — please review and sign so we can attach it to PO 8421.

4) AP contact: Rajiv Menon (rajiv.menon@bellwetherhealth.com) will be the lockbox contact for mapping. Rajiv, can you confirm the exact CSV column order your ERP expects and the lockbox account numbers?

We will hold invoicing until the amendment is executed and remittance account is confirmed. For transparency, I attached our W9 for your vendor record.

Thanks everyone — happy to jump on a 20-min call if that accelerates things.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Manager, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0142
Attachments: W9_Redwood_Inference.pdf; payment_amendment_draft_BW-8421.pdf
